item.title: Build a Website for 59-Second AI Videos With Buy Buttons
item.description:
250-750 USD | I want a website that helps people sell their books and products on social media without having to make or post the videos themselves. A user adds a book or product, connects their social accounts, and sets a schedule. The website creates the videos and posts them with a buy button for the exact item featured.
**How it should work**
1. **Add a book or product.** For a book, the user uploads a Word or PDF manuscript and the cover. For a product, such as a shirt, they enter a description and upload any photos they want used. In either case, they provide the exact product listing or purchase link.
2. **Connect accounts and set a schedule.** Each user connects their own YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok accounts. They choose where to post and set the days, times, and time zone for each account.
3. **Create the video.** The website uses AI to write the script and create the narration, visuals, and captions. The entire finished video must be **59 seconds or less**, including the closing sales message. If it’s too long, the website shortens it and makes a new version automatically.
4. **Post automatically or ask for approval first.** In automatic mode, videos go live on schedule without the user having to review them or finish the upload. In approval mode, the user can preview and approve a video or tap **Generate a New Video** if they don’t like it. The replacement promotes the same item and must be approved before it goes live. If the scheduled time passes without approval, hold the post.
5. **Put a buy button on every post.** Viewers should be able to tap a buy button or product tag on the post itself and go straight to the exact book or product. A link in the bio or a picture of a button doesn’t count.
**User dashboard**
Show the **next five videos in the posting queue**, including what each video promotes, where and when it will post, and whether it’s awaiting approval. Let users preview, approve, or regenerate a video from the queue. Show the schedule for each connected account and let users edit it.
**If a platform can’t do this**
Explain in your bid which part won’t work and why. Suggest the simplest alternative that keeps the process mostly hands-off. Spell out what the user has to do once, what they’d have to do for each video, and any extra costs. Don’t publish without a buy button unless the user has chosen that alternative.
**Please break your bid into three separate prices**
1. **Pilot:** Use one book and one product, such as a shirt. Show which platforms can publish a scheduled video automatically with a working buy button that takes a viewer to the correct listing. Also demonstrate the dashboard, how a rejected video gets replaced, and that an unapproved video stays unpublished in approval mode. 2. **Full website:** Build the browser-based version first. It should work on desktop, iPad, and phone without a download. This is the version I plan to launch first. 3. **Mobile app later:** Give me a separate price for an iPhone and iPad app after the website is built. If you can also build an Android version, price that separately. Explain how customers would keep the same login, products, connected accounts, and schedules.
Include a timeline for each phase and list ongoing costs separately. **The mobile app is for pricing only right now. It won’t be awarded as part of the website project and will be listed on Freelancer separately.**

item.title: Build B2B Wholesale Ordering Portal wordPress
item.description:
20-250 GBP | WordPress B2B Wholesale Ordering Portal (Phased Build)
Project Summary: We are upgrading an existing live WordPress site into a private, gated B2B wholesale ordering portal for a poultry and egg supplier in Southern Africa. Wholesale pricing and ordering must be restricted to verified business buyers, support local currency (NAD / N$) and 15% VAT rules, enable fast bulk ordering, and automate order alerts and back-office workflows across structured phases. All client, business, pricing, and buyer details are strictly confidential. We are looking for quotes broken down clearly by phase so we can review scope, timelines, and milestones.
Phase Breakdown: * Phase 1 — Gated B2B Portal, Bulk Ordering & Instant Alerts * Clone the live WordPress site to a private staging environment with zero downtime to the live site. * Build a B2B registration workflow capturing company details, business registration numbers, and VAT/tax IDs, with a manual admin approval step (pending vs. approved) that gates wholesale pricing and checkout. * Configure NAD / N$ currency, 15% VAT calculation, product listings (SKUs, pack sizes, stock status, and minimum order quantities), and a fast spreadsheet/matrix-style bulk order sheet. * Set up Direct Bank Transfer (EFT) checkout, automated order confirmation emails to buyers and internal office/accounts addresses, and real-time mobile/WhatsApp order notifications. * Structure product, customer, and order data cleanly so Phase 2 can plug in without refactoring the core setup.
* Phase 2 — Warehouse Operations & Financial Document Automation * Generate consolidated picking and packing lists for warehouse/ground staff (sorted by product type and delivery route/schedule). * Auto-generate itemized driver delivery notes with delivery details and customer sign-off blocks. * Implement clear order status stages (e.g., Pending, Paid, Processing, Packed, Dispatched, Delivered). * Generate tax invoices for accounting and support credit notes (for adjustments such as weight or quantity variances).
* Phase 3 — Online Payments & Scaling Enhancements * Integrate online card/local payment gateway options and support refund workflows alongside EFT. * Support future operational scaling (such as standing/recurring orders, catch-weight adjustments, or reorder tracking).
How to Quote:
Please include: * Separate cost estimates and estimated timelines for Phase 1, Phase 2, and Phase 3 (and note if you recommend milestone splits within each phase). * Relevant past work building gated B2B wholesale portals, bulk order forms, order alerts, and fulfillment/invoicing workflows. * Any clarifying questions before we share staging details under confidentiality.
